name: quanty
description: Zero-dependency number & byte formatting toolkit — formatBytes, parseBytes, formatNumber, formatCompact (si/zh), ordinal. Library + CLI, runs in Node and the browser.

scripts.demo: node bin/quanty.js bytes 1536 && node bin/quanty.js compact 1500000 --style zh && node bin/quanty.js ordinal 22 --lang zh
